cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

mechanism: A bargains for impossible payment while treating its pupil negotiated exceptions and new fear as opportunities to correct old habits.
confusable: Not a merely eccentric gift: each requested favor receives its own symbolic price, adjusted to the pupil actual objection.
comparison: Negotiated shadow hours and stored fear versus patiently maturing payment in time.
seedUse: D166 ladder/shadow/work/evenings/fear; S05 teaching negotiation and old fear.
